author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete:
- GO:0060071 Wnt signaling pathway, planar cell polarity pathway
- GO:2000095 regulation of Wnt signaling pathway, planar cell polarity pathway
- GO:2000096 positive regulation of Wnt signaling pathway, planar cell polarity pathway
- GO:0141113 negative regulation of Wnt signaling pathway, planar cell polarity pathway

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32697

The reason for obsoletion is that Wnt/PCP signaling does not exist as a separate signaling process; rather, the Wnt component can regulate planar cell polarity in some systems.

Annotations that need to be reviewed are here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1G0QOTiERRxgrQ7EyiZwC6wc2FPwAd12X7alyH_8VrlE

Impacted groups (experimental annotations):
MGI	62
ZFIN	9
UniProt	8 - done
BHF-UCL	7
ParkinsonsUK-UCL	5
WB	2
FlyBase	1 - DONE
AgBase	1

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule, Reactome)
* Reactome:R-HSA-4086400 (reactome2go) → GO:0060071

Annotation extensions that need to be reviewed:
* 24 annotations to other terms use these terms in extensions (ParkinsonsUK-UCL 19, MGI 5): https://github.com/geneontology/go-annotation/blob/master/reports/6651/extensions_GO_0060071-GO_0141113-GO_2000095-GO_2000096.tsv

Thanks.
title: Review annotations to 4 Wnt/PCP terms (go-ontology#32697)
